description: This file defines a PHP class 'Smarty_Internal_Runtime_FilterHandler' which manages filter processing for the Smarty template engine. It handles running autoloaded and registered filters on template content, including dynamic plugin loading and error handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_FilterHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for executing filters on template content within the Smarty templating engine, supporting both autoloaded and registered filters, with dynamic plugin loading.

methods.name: runFilter
methods.description: Executes the specified type of filters ('pre', 'post', 'output') on the given content, handling autoloaded plugins, registered filters, and error cases.
